Courses Offered
See our​
Courses Offered
A.  Two Years Higher Secondary Course in Science and Arts under AHSEC (Assam Higher Secondary Education Council).
B.  Three Years Degree Course in Science and Arts under Bodoland University, Kokrajhar.
C.  Two Years PG Course in Economics & Geography.
Subjects Offered
1.  H.S. (HIGHER SECONDARY) :
ARTS:
(a)  English, (b) Assamese/Bodo/Alt. English, (c) History, (d) Political Science/ Advance Languages, (e) Economics, (f) Geography, (g) Education, (h)  Logic and Philosophy, (i)  Mathematics.
SCIENCE:
(a)  English, (b) Assamese/Bodo/Alt. English, (c) Physics, (d) Chemistry, (e) Mathematics, (f) Biology, (g) Geography.
2.  T.D.C. (THREE YEAR DEGREE COURSE) / SEMESTER:
ARTS:
HONOURS:
Assamese, Bodo, English, Economics, Education, History, Philosophy, Political Science, Geography & Mathematics.
REGULAR:
Assamese, Bodo, English, Economics, Education, History, Philosophy, Political Science, Geography, Mathematics, Bodo Elective and Assamese Elective.
SCIENCE:
HONOURS:
Botany, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Zoology.
REGULAR:
Botany, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Zoology & Geography.
N.B.:
Science students are also permitted to opt. honours in Geography.
TDC Semester System:
The Semester system has been introduced in the College from the academic session 2012-2013. The schedule of the semester is as follows:-
(a)  First, Third and Fifth  Semester: 1st August-31st December.
(b)  Second, Fourth and Sixth Semester: 1st January-30th June.
In the Semester system, students performance is monitored by continuous assessment and evaluation in all subjects.
